assertion.en: A bakery that spends all its time on baking and none on marketing and sales may still find it hard to sell its goods.

reason.en: The marketing and sales team brings in customers and persuades them to buy the products.

b.en: Both are true, and the Reason explains the Assertion: without marketing and sales, fewer people hear about the bakery and buy.

c.en: The Reason is true: bringing in customers and persuading them to buy is the work of marketing and sales.

d.en: The Assertion is true: good bread does not sell if few people know the bakery is there.

explanation.en: Both are true, and the Reason explains the Assertion. Marketing and sales brings customers in, so a bakery that skips it may bake well and still sell little.

hints.en: Think of who tells people about the new mango cake.
